#en: No, they didn't. Per usual. And don't think I didn't notice you changing the subject!
zh: 不，没有。一如往常。别以为我没注意到你在转移话题！

#en: You already have this Cyberamp, but I can pull data to build you an upgraded version?
zh: 你已经有这个赛博增幅了，但我可以调取数据给你造个升级版？

#en: I believe I've found a way to mine additional data -- from Watchtower Computer Cores.
zh: 我想我找到了挖掘更多数据的办法——从瞭望塔的计算机核心。

#en: I'll ping you the coordinates. Check it out if you're feeling brave! Until next time.
zh: 我把坐标发你。有胆量就去看看！下次见。

#en: Okay, then! I've got some connections I can tap. Their help won't come cheap, though.
zh: 那好！我有些关系可以动用。不过他们的帮助不便宜。

#en: Oh. Good thinking! I kinda forgot about that... Glad your memory is better than mine!
zh: 哦。想得好！我都快忘了……幸好你记性比我好！

#en: Gren and Harper are back on the station and waiting to meet you, so let's get moving.
zh: 格伦和哈珀回站里了，正等着见你，我们走吧。

#en: And there it is. I see the facility. Still buried under ice. Guess it's Skydrop time!
zh: 就是那儿。我看到设施了。还埋在冰下。看来得用空投了！

#en: Or did you just want a reminder of what it feels like to have your neurons scrambled?
zh: 还是你只是想重温一下神经元被打乱的感觉？

#en: Meet me at Stardock, and we can start putting our fleet together. See you there soon!
zh: 到星坞来找我，我们开始组建舰队。那儿见！

#en: Though, there seems to be exceptions. I noticed Alpha Centauri is curiously avoided...
zh: 不过，似乎也有例外。我注意到南门二阿尔法星被奇怪地避开了……

#en: ...Tsk. Encrypted. Not surprising. Let's run this through Gren's cracking algorithm...
zh: ……啧。加密了。不意外。我们拿格伦的破解算法跑一遍……

#en: Most Watchtower members undergo "changes" to enhance them for their particular duties.
zh: 大多数瞭望塔成员都会经历「变化」，以强化其特定职责。

#en: Stardock! Well, now it is. But it's really only had that name for the past few months.
zh: 星坞！嗯，现在算。但这名字其实也就用了几个月。

#en: We've got a previous model of this Amp. But with a little more data, I can enhance it.
zh: 我们有这个增幅的前一代型号。但只要再多点数据，我就能强化它。

#en: But whatever this purpose is, they keep it locked behind many, many layers of secrecy.
zh: 但不管这目的是什么，他们都用层层保密锁得死死的。

#en: What kind, depends on their role. My modifications were tailored for ship engineering.
zh: 什么类型取决于职责。我的改造是为飞船工程量身定做的。

#en: Let's see what changes you want. But, you should also consider building more Skydrops.
zh: 看看你想改什么。不过，你也该考虑多造些空投。

#en: Also checked the rest of the Slates, they weren't empty. Found more Listening Posts...
zh: 我把其余的数据板也查了，并不是空的。又找到几处监听哨……

#en: And there's more! Found some extra Post locations on the other slates you handed me...
zh: 还有更多！你交来的其他数据板上还有些监听哨位置……

#en: I know a certain group... Very reliable, trustworthy, but they won't do it for free...
zh: 我认识一伙人……很可靠，信得过，但他们不会白干……

#en: Okay, but you've gotta tell me, do you want to play it safe or dive into the deep end?
zh: 行，但你得告诉我，你想求稳还是往深水里跳？

#en: Alright, let's see. Do you want a low-risk system, or are you lookin' for some action?
zh: 好，那看看。你想要低风险星系，还是想找点刺激？

#en: Huh. Evidently, pulling that Control Node -- had one or two unforeseen consequences...
zh: 哦。显然，取那控制节点——带来了一两个没预料到的后果……

#en: Stay sharp down there! Remember, my Grav Shift might not bring me back close to you...
zh: 下面保持警觉！记住，我的重力位移未必能落回你附近……

#en: Mining samples are stored on the ship. Please remain two meters away, for your safety.
zh: 采矿样本存放在船上。为了你的安全，请保持两米距离。

#en: Ha-ha! Didn't stand a chance! Not with the two of us taking them by surprise, that is.
zh: 哈哈！它们毫无机会！尤其我们俩还打了它们个措手不及。

#en: It doesn't matter who we are. You've been flagged as a threat to others, and yourself.
zh: 我们是谁不重要。你已被标记为对他人及自身的威胁。

#en: Let's get back to your ship and make orbit. We can go look for this Surveillance Array.
zh: 我们回你的飞船入轨。可以去找这个监视阵列。

#en: Altair III, huh? We'll have to do a scan of the planet, see if we can pick anything up.
zh: 牵牛III，是吧？我们得扫描一下这颗行星，看看能不能捕捉到什么。

#en: Skydrops can be of great aid. Especially for those who often find themselves in combat.
zh: 空投能帮上大忙。尤其对常陷于战斗的人。

#en: Don't forget, Watchtower are still out there. Without a second ship, you're vulnerable.
zh: 别忘了，瞭望塔还在外面。没有第二艘船，你就很脆弱。

#en: Unwell? No. In fact, right now I'm likely in better health than anyone on this station.
zh: 不舒服？没有。其实我现在可能比这站里任何人都健康。

#en: Hm. I think if Harper were to rejoin, these days she'd find us much more to her liking.
zh: 嗯。我想哈珀要是回来，如今她会觉得我们更合她意。

#en: However, I'm told that's normal, so in that case, the operation was a complete success!
zh: 不过，人说这是正常的，那么这次手术就是彻底成功！

#en: You're welcome. Hm! Drool running down your chin, and still, impeccable manners. Bravo!
zh: 不客气。嗯！口水都流到下巴了，礼数还这么周全。漂亮！

#en: There's the Watchtower site. Buried in ice, naturally. Skydrop's still the only way in!
zh: 瞭望塔的地点在那儿。当然，埋在冰里。空投仍是唯一的进入方式！

#en: I won't waste too much time rehashing what we've already done. So let's just get to it!
zh: 我不多费时间重复做过的部分。直接开始吧！

#en: And if we don't see each other again... best of luck! I got complete confidence in you.
zh: 要是我们不再见面……祝你好运！我对你完全有信心。

#en: As long as you're not planning on running any marathons, you should be fine down there!
zh: 只要你不打算跑马拉松，在下面应该没事！

#en: Feeling's mutual! It's nice to have some company. You know, company that remembers you.
zh: 我也有同感！有人作伴真好。你知道，是记得你的那种伴。

#en: And since all I needed to know was engineering, what information I can share is limited.
zh: 而既然我只需要懂工程，能分享的信息也有限。

#en: If I'd stayed put, Watchtower would've snagged 'em for sure. I couldn't let that happen!
zh: 我要是原地不动，瞭望塔肯定会把他们抓走。我不能让那种事发生！

#en: This Amp heightens one's ability to synchronize missile systems, reducing reload delays.
zh: 这个增幅能提升导弹系统同步能力，缩短装填延迟。

#en: Though the strain is... considerable. There's always a cost to pushing limits like that.
zh: 尽管负荷……相当大。那样逼极限总得有代价。

#en: That's why I'm here. And just a reminder, we have a Skydrop unit ready for installation.
zh: 所以我在这儿。顺便提醒，我们有一个空投可以安装。

#en: That was the wake-up call I needed to get the hell outta there! And I never looked back.
zh: 那就是我需要的警钟，让我赶紧离开那儿！我再也没回头。

#en: More people showing up, more ships docking... I might have to start hiring outside help!
zh: 来的人更多了，靠港的船也更多……我可能得开始雇外面的帮手了！

#en: I'll ping my contacts now. But don't expect instant results! It'll take a little time...
zh: 我这就联系我的关系。但别指望立竿见影！要花点时间……

#en: Am I shocked you had your own solution in mind...? Nah. I should've expected it, really!
zh: 你心里另有打算，我惊讶吗……？不。我早该想到的，真的！

#en: So don't wait for me! Head into the facility and find the Control Node. Alright, then...
zh: 别等我！进设施找控制节点。那好……

#en: And don't forget about that mech! I'll be ready to drop my ship on it once it comes out.
zh: 别忘了那台机甲！它一出来，我就准备好把飞船砸下去。

#en: Right you are! Watchtower are back in full force, so let's get to rebuilding your fleet.
zh: 说得对！瞭望塔卷土重来，我们开始重建你的舰队吧。

#en: Welcome to Stardock Alpha! My current home away from home. Glad you found your way here!
zh: 欢迎来到星坞阿尔法！我现在的第二个家。很高兴你找到这儿！

#en: Why am I not surprised? Don't expect any sympathy from me. You brought this on yourself.
zh: 我怎么一点都不惊讶？别指望我同情你。这是你自找的。

#en: If you've got questions about that sorta thing, best ask Gren. He'd know all the details.
zh: 你要是对那种事有疑问，最好问格伦。他清楚所有细节。

#en: Maybe! From what I read, does look like they've got Listening Posts in most every system.
zh: 也许吧！从我读到的看，他们几乎每个星系都有监听哨。

#en: Hello again, I'm glad you're here. Since we last spoke, I've been thinking things over...
zh: 又见面了，很高兴你来了。上次谈过之后，我一直在琢磨……

#en: That's... a long story. I can tell you the whole thing, if you like? Or, I can summarize.
zh: 那……说来话长。你想听全部经过吗？或者我说个概要。

#en: Hah! That's not his real name, of course. It's more like an "alias". He's a Cyber Runner!
zh: 哈！那当然不是他的真名。更像是个「化名」。他是电子情报贩！

#en: I'll reach out, but it's gonna take a while for someone to get back to me. Take a seat...
zh: 我去联系，但得等一阵才有人回我。坐会儿吧……

#en: I know someone. They're good at sniffing out hidden spots, but their help won't be cheap.
zh: 我认识个人。擅长嗅出隐蔽地点，但帮忙不便宜。

#en: Yup! This particular make and model is exactly what we need. At least, according to Gren.
zh: 没错！就是这个型号规格，正是我们要的。至少格伦是这么说的。

#en: Oh... Right, uh, yeah. We've not really been introduced yet, have we? Let's rectify that!
zh: 哦……对，呃，是啊。我们还没正式认识过，对吧？这就补上！

#en: But what if you weren't by yourself...? What if you had -- the support of other ships...?
zh: 但要是你不是孤身一人呢……？要是你有——其他飞船的支援呢……？

#en: I mean, there's gotta be something! Otherwise Watchtower wouldn't have taken an interest.
zh: 我是说，肯定有什么原因！否则瞭望塔不会感兴趣。

#en: When Watchtower came for you, I'm sure their method of capture didn't escape your notice.
zh: 瞭望塔来找你的时候，我想你不会没注意到他们抓捕的方式。

#en: We... really need to stop meeting like this. And I mean that. How many times is this now?
zh: 我们……真的不能再这样见面了。我是认真的。这是第几次了？

#en: Uh... Get back to your ship and meet me in orbit. We can look for this Surveillance Array.
zh: 呃……回你的飞船，到轨道上跟我碰头。我们可以去找这个监视阵列。

#en: Before we head out, we should check in with Gren. He can help us put our fleet together...
zh: 出发前，我们该联系一下格伦。他能帮我们组建舰队……

#en: Tell you what, you can loan my old vessel. It's not much to look at, but it'll do the job.
zh: 这样吧，你可以借用我的旧船。卖相一般，但能干活。

#en: Hah. When crashing your ship into a planet, uh, there's not exactly a safe way to do that!
zh: 哈。拿飞船撞行星，呃，可没什么安全的做法！

#en: If I hadn't bailed, Watchtower would have 'em in chains by now. So, you understand, right?
zh: 我要是没跑，瞭望塔现在早把他们锁起来了。所以，你理解吧？

#en: Enhances cognitive mapping abilities, letting someone execute grav jumps more efficiently.
zh: 强化认知制图能力，让人能更高效地执行重力跃迁。

#en: You're missing the required number of cores for this one. I can't extract it without more.
zh: 这个你缺所需数量的核心。没有更多我提取不了。

#en: This tech is a little outside my usual practice, but nothing I can't handle. One moment...
zh: 这技术有点超出我平时的范畴，但难不倒我。稍等……

#en: On impact, releases a cryogenic blast that freezes targets, immobilizing them temporarily.
zh: 命中时释放低温冲击，冻结目标，使其短暂无法行动。

#en: Anyway, what we managed to pull data on, is blueprints for some of Watchtower's neuroamps.
zh: 总之，我们提取到的数据是瞭望塔一些神经增幅器的图纸。

#en: I'll get on it right away. Be ready to hand over some credits! It's how these things work.
zh: 我马上就去办。准备好掏钱！这种事就是这样。

#en: I'll take a crack at it. Just tell me, quiet system, or one that'll keep you on your toes?
zh: 我试试看。只要告诉我，要安静的星系，还是让你时刻紧张的那种？

#en: The Advocate won't work for free, and seems we've not got enough Astra to cover her costs.
zh: 辩护者不会白干，而我们似乎没有足够的阿斯特拉支付她的费用。

#en: I'll go get my ship prepped. The Fleet-Sync Control Node is waiting for us on Eridani III!
zh: 我去准备飞船。舰队同步控制节点在波江座III等着我们！

#en: Now you're thinking like a Starborn! I... dunno if that's good, or a bad thing, but still.
zh: 这才像星裔的思路！我……不知道这是好事还是坏事，不过还是。

#en: Well, that's a fine hello! Hah. But I think you might be right about that "paths" thing...
zh: 哟，这招呼打得真好！哈。不过我觉得你说那「路径」的事可能真没错……

#en: Okay, let's recap: Universe, new. Watchtower, bad. Fleet, needed. Plan? Same as last time!
zh: 好，我们梳理一下：宇宙，新的。瞭望塔，坏的。舰队，需要的。计划？跟上次一样！

#en: But, I'm fairly sure you're you! Hah, and it looks like I found you not a moment too late.
zh: 但我相当确定你还是你！哈，看来我找到你的时机刚好。

#en: Perhaps Torin already explained this, but Skydrop systems are usually large and cumbersome.
zh: 也许托林已经解释过，但空投系统通常又大又笨重。

#en: Ah, sorry. Yeah, I kinda trashed it. Along with the Skydrop system you installed into it...
zh: 啊，抱歉。是啊，我把它弄毁了。连你装进去的空投系统一起……

#en: This one's a bit unclear, but it seems to elevate some of the user's baseline capabilities.
zh: 这个不太明确，但似乎能提升使用者某些基础能力。

#en: This will be highly experimental, but what do you say? Have I the go-ahead to attempt this?
zh: 这会高度实验性，你觉得如何？我可以动手试试吗？

#en: A new type of Cyberamp, one that could greatly improve both social and combat capabilities!
zh: 一种新型赛博增幅，能大幅提升社交和战斗能力！

#en: You already own this type of Amp, but with some additional data, I could refine it further.
zh: 你已经有这类增幅了，但再多些数据，我能进一步精炼它。

#en: Not too sure... But, from what I could dig up, I think it was mostly for political reasons.
zh: 不太确定……但据我挖到的，我想多半是政治原因。

#en: After a while I figured there was nothing for me in Neon, so I got out! Left it all behind.
zh: 过了一阵我明白霓虹城没什么适合我的，就走了！全都抛在身后。

#en: Like I said, stuff like body mods, organ replacements, and a bunch of other crazy things...
zh: 就像我说的，身体改造、器官置换，还有一堆别的疯狂东西……

#en: Yeah, found mentions of it, sure, but no solid data on how to actually reproduce any of it.
zh: 是啊，确实发现过相关提及，但没有能真正复现的可靠数据。

#en: You must really hate mechs! Feeling okay? Little woozy? It'll pass. Alright, time to leave.
zh: 你肯定很恨机甲！还好吗？有点晕？会过去的。好，该走了。

#en: Stay safe, and remember, when I Grav Shift, it'll likely take me far from your position....
zh: 注意安全，记住，我重力位移后很可能离你很远……

#en: Yeah, Zippy, I know what your name is. Although, the "space adventurer" part is news to me!
zh: 是啊，齐皮，我知道你叫什么。不过「太空冒险家」这头衔我还是头回听说！

#en: I'll be waiting for you at Stardock. Don't keep me waiting long! We got a fleet to rebuild!
zh: 我在星坞等你。别让我等太久！我们还有舰队要重建！

#en: Offer's still on the table! Bunch of Credits to take care of that Watchtower Listening Post.
zh: 提议还有效！一大笔信用点，换你处理掉那个瞭望塔监听哨。

#en: Though firstly, we need a ship assigned to your fleet. Or we'll be easy prey for Watchtower.
zh: 不过首先，我们得给你的舰队分配一艘船。否则我们会是瞭望塔的猎物。

#en: I... I recall one time, we were deployed to a small colony, it was under siege by pirates...
zh: 我……我记得有一次，我们被派到一个小殖民地，那里正被海盗围困……

#en: I'd heard the term before, but didn't know its meaning. Turned out, the "Deviant" was Torin.
zh: 我以前听过这词，但不知道意思。原来那个「异常体」就是托林。

#en: As I previously mentioned, most every Watchtower member undergoes some kind of modification.
zh: 如我之前所说，几乎每个瞭望塔成员都受过某种改造。

#en: All right. Let's modify your vessel. But... you really should bring me more Watchtower tech.
zh: 好。我们改装你的飞船。不过……你真该多给我带些瞭望塔技术。

#en: Can do. And, if you bring me more Watchtower tech, we can later work on Skydrops to install.
zh: 没问题。而且你要是多带些瞭望塔技术来，我们之后还能搞空投来装。

#en: We'll be safer back at Stardock, we can talk more there. And also get started on your fleet!
zh: 回星坞更安全，我们那儿再细谈。顺便开始弄你的舰队！

#en: Maybe now you're starting to get a picture on why Watchtower might be scared of you, huh...?
zh: 也许现在你开始明白瞭望塔为什么怕你了，嗯……？

#en: Huh...? They're bouncing some sort of... signal off of our transmitter array! Cutting power!
zh: 嗯……？他们在用我们的发射天线阵列反射某种……信号！切断电源！

#en: Harper, is there any way we could find more of these Listening Posts and Surveillance Arrays?
zh: 哈珀，有办法找到更多这种监听哨和监视阵列吗？

#en: Maybe. But there's no way you could've known what would happen. Don't be so hard on yourself.
zh: 也许吧。但你不可能预知会发生什么。别太苛责自己。

#en: And now I am doubly glad -- that I began work on building a second Skydrop deployment system.
zh: 现在我更加庆幸——我开始着手建造第二套空投部署系统。

#en: These changes aren't entirely positive, however. There's always a number of... complications.
zh: 不过这些变化并非全是好事。总会有不少……并发症。

#en: Harper! I know what you're going to say, and you're right. But hear me out! My friend here...
zh: 哈珀！我知道你要说什么，你说得对。但听我说完！我这位朋友……

#en: As you may know, it started as a mining colony, but over time, grew into a full-fledged city.
zh: 你可能知道，它起初是个采矿殖民地，但随时间发展成了完整的城市。

#en: I set my sights higher, to the stars. So I started teaching myself ship repair, construction.
zh: 我把目光投向更高处，投向星海。于是我开始自学飞船维修和建造。

#en: Are you asking that 'cause he's ex-Watchtower? Or you got some other reason to be worried...?
zh: 你问这个是因为他是前瞭望塔成员？还是有别的理由担心……？

#en: Transferring the coordinates. Take a look if and when you're ready. And stay sharp out there!
zh: 正在传送坐标。你方便时就去看看。外面保持警觉！

#en: Ugh. Just can't help yourself, huh? Alright. I'll be in the corvette! Send some power my way.
zh: 唉。你就是忍不住，是吧？行。我在护卫舰里！给我送点电过来。

#en: ...I guess hacking it works too. You know, if you're enough of a nerd for that kinda thing...
zh: ……我猜黑进去也行。你知道，只要你对那种事够宅的话……

#en: Whew! Wasn't too far away this time. Still had to jog, though... *inhale* Okay. I'm with you!
zh: 呼！这次没跑太远。不过还是得小跑过来……*吸气* 好。我到了！

#en: Don't wait around on my account! Make your way into the facility and locate the Control Node.
zh: 别为了我在这儿干等！进设施去，找到控制节点。

#en: Hmm... Air inside of the Stardock feels a little dryer. That's about all I've noticed so far.
zh: 嗯……星坞里面的空气感觉干一点。目前我就注意到这些。

#en: Okay, how-- how do I say this... Everyone has... potential, though most never quite reach it.
zh: 好，这——这怎么说呢……每个人都有……潜力，只是大多数人从未真正触及。

#en: Y'know... one of these days, I might not make it here in time! And what will you do then, hm?
zh: 你知道……总有一天我会赶不上！到时候你怎么办，嗯？

#en: Hm. If we want access to that Listening Post, we're gonna have to deal with these guys first..
zh: 嗯。想去那个监听哨，我们得先解决这些人……

#en: Well, in that case, if we come across any Watchtower materials, we'll be sure to let you know!
zh: 那样的话，要是我们遇到瞭望塔的材料，一定告诉你！

#en: Every new face I see, it reminds me of why I started this. Everyone needs somewhere to belong.
zh: 每见到一张新面孔，我就想起自己为什么开始做这个。每个人都需要一个归属。

#en: Dammit, dammit, sorry *sigh* I should've remembered. We'll have to take this thing down again.
zh: 该死，该死，抱歉 *叹气* 我该记得的。我们得再把这东西放倒一次。

#en: Oh, and the mech? The second it shows its face, me and the Perseverance will show it what for.
zh: 哦，那台机甲？它一露头，我和坚毅号就会教它做人。

#en: Might be a day or two before I've got anything. Find a bunk, get some rest! I'll see you soon.
zh: 我可能一两天才有消息。找个床铺休息一下！回头见。

#en: These coordinates don't look right... This needs to be exact, so grab the flare and try again.
zh: 这些坐标看着不对……这必须精确，拿起信号弹再试一次。

#en: Eridani III isn't ideal, but I've seen folks settle worse planets. Why's there no colony here?
zh: 波江座III不理想，但我见过有人定居更糟的行星。这儿为什么没有殖民地？

#en: Alright, power up your scanners and do a sweep of the planet, see if we can find our facility.
zh: 好，启动扫描器，把行星扫一遍，看能不能找到我们的设施。

#en: Before revealing the specifics, I'll let your imagination run wild just a little while longer.
zh: 在揭晓细节之前，让你再自由想象一会儿。

#en: Still, I can't imagine anything else I'd wanna do. It's an unconventional life, but it's mine.
zh: 不过，我想不出别的更想做的事。这生活不寻常，但它是我的。

#en: Okay, think of it like this. Remember when Watchtower hit you with that first Disruptor blast?
zh: 好，这么想。记得瞭望塔第一次用干扰器轰你的时候吗？

#en: But the more I learn about them, the more I know -- I don't want them anywhere near my station.
zh: 但我越了解他们，就越清楚——我不想他们靠近我的空间站。

#en: Oh, right! About that... My ship and the Skydrop system you fitted to it, they're toast. Sorry.
zh: 哦，对！关于那个……我的飞船和你装上去的空投系统，都毁了。抱歉。

#en: And when I'm not patching people up, I enjoy reading. Ah, and I've been known to paint. Poorly.
zh: 不给人包扎的时候，我喜欢读书。啊，我还画过画。画得很差。

#en: This Amp I'm not too sure on, but it does appear to boost some of the user's natural abilities.
zh: 这个增幅我不太确定，但似乎能增强使用者的一些天赋。

#en: I dug through the rest of the slates -- and found some additional Listening Post coordinates...
zh: 我把其余数据板翻了个遍——又找到些监听哨坐标……

#en: Hah. You'll get no argument from me! Like I said, I'll have to remember that one for next time.
zh: 哈。我可不会跟你争！就像我说的，这招我得记着下次用。

#en: I mean, I'm ninety-nine percent sure I'm still the same me, and that you're still the same you.
zh: 我是说，我百分之九十九确定我还是我，你也还是你。

#en: Yeah, I'm sorry, I didn't mean to bail on you like that. But I'll make it up to you, I promise!
zh: 是啊，抱歉，我不是故意那样丢下你。但我会补偿你，我保证！

#en: You've not met him yet. But once we're back at Stardock, I'll make the necessary introductions.
zh: 你还没见过他。等我们回到星坞，我会做必要的介绍。

#en: You should've known they'd attack you. You can't trust them! At least, not this group. Not yet.
zh: 你早该知道他们会攻击你。不能信他们！至少这伙人不行。还不行。

#en: I'd guess because it's too hot for 'em there. Too many eyes watching, too many nosy officials...
zh: 我猜因为那儿对他们太烫手。眼睛太多，多事的官员也太多……

#en: I thought he was just some spacer -- trying to muscle me out. Almost blew him out of an airlock!
zh: 我以为他只是个太空客——想把我挤走。差点把他扔出气闸！

#en: Naturally! You put a lot of work into that stuff. Taking care of it all is the least I could do!
zh: 当然！你为那些东西花了那么多心血。照看好它们是我起码该做的！

#en: We're alive, aren't we? Eh, don't worry about it. Still, you should probably work on your intel!
zh: 我们不还活着吗？嗯，别在意。不过你大概该提高一下情报水平！

#en: And so I deserted. Not something Watchtower takes kindly to. But for that to become a problem...
zh: 于是我当了逃兵。瞭望塔可不喜欢这种事。但那要成为问题……

#en: Harper, I'm so sorry I left the station unattended, but you see, I had to rescue my friend here.
zh: 哈珀，很抱歉我让空间站无人看守，但你看，我得救我这位朋友。

#en: Ship scrapped, transferring the credits. Vessel had usable Watchtower components too. Take them.
zh: 飞船已拆解，正在转账。那艘船还有可用的瞭望塔部件。拿去吧。

#en: Had to struggle to understand even basic engineering concepts, let alone keep it all in my head.
zh: 连基本的工程概念我都得苦苦琢磨，更别说全记在脑子里。

#en: As I explained before, Watchtower is a highly-secretive organization, even to those within it...
zh: 如我之前解释的，瞭望塔是个高度保密的组织，对内部人也是如此……

#en: I've got someone in mind who can help us. They're dependable, but they don't do favors for free.
zh: 我心里有个人能帮忙。他们可靠，但不白帮忙。

#en: One small snafu. Corvette doesn't have power... But it is umbilicaled to the facility's reactor!
zh: 出了点小岔子。护卫舰没电……但它用脐带连着设施的核反应堆！

#en: This'll take some time. Get some rest, and I'll bring you up to speed as soon as I've something!
zh: 这要花些时间。去休息吧，一有消息我马上跟你同步！

#en: Feelings mutual! It's nice to have familiar company. You know, hehe, company that remembers you.
zh: 我也有同感！有熟人作伴真好。你知道，嘿嘿，是记得你的那种伴。

#en: In order for Skydrop to work, the ship deploying needs pinpoint coordinates, and a drop request.
zh: 空投要生效，投放的飞船需要精确坐标，以及投放请求。

#en: Huh. Yeah, you got a point! I wouldn't want to live there, but it's far from a barren wasteland.
zh: 哦。是啊，你说得对！我不想住那儿，但远算不上荒芜之地。

#en: And as long as your ship has power, it needs to hit you at least twice in order to incapacitate.
zh: 只要你的飞船有电，它至少要击中你两次才能让你失去行动力。

#en: Wh-- uh... Okay, um, didn't expect you to say that. That... that actually caught me off guard...
zh: 什——呃……好吧，嗯，没想到你会这么说。那……那还真让我措手不及……

#en: Thought I was pretty clear. I don't want some creepy listening post near my home! Simple as that.
zh: 我以为我说得很清楚。我不想家附近有个诡异的监听哨！就这么简单。
